attempts.queryPreview:
query loadGame(
  $gameIds: [String]
  $categoryId: String
  $limit: Int
  $published: Boolean
  $released: Boolean
  $sort: String
  $tags: [String]
) {
  games(
    gameIds: $gameIds
    categoryId: $categoryId
    published: $published
    released: $released
    limit: $limit
    sort: $sort
    tags: $tags
  ) {
    id
    categoryId
    subCategoryId
    order
    title
    titleOverride
    imageSlug
    providerId
    added
    backgroundColour
    link
    video
    jackpot {
      id
      amount
    }
    labelText
  }
}
